name: Adaptive

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This armor can temporarily grow new locomotion limbs under your control, such as wings or fins. As a 3-action activity with the manipulate trait, you can gain your choice of a climb or swim Speed of 15 feet for 1 minute. If the armor has the resilient trait, you can instead gain a burrow or fly Speed of 15 feet.
